subject: ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause
notes: kb/Work PB1072 landed (w61c). cite.py --check 12.4.5.6.3 'Literal-1 shall be an alphanumeric literal, a national literal, or a figurative constant' / 'shall be of the same category as data-name-1 or data-name-2' / 'If ALL literal is specified, the literal shall be one character long' -> OK SR7. Three FileControlKeyRules rows, one rule-id: the operand's kind (numeric literal, boolean literal, NULL refused), its category against data-name-1's, and an ALL literal's length; COBOL0863. The operand is read ONCE by DataBinder.ReadSuppressWhen through the literal-position chokepoint RawValueOperandText (grammar alternateKeySuppressWhen now takes valueClauseOperand), so a constant-name (13.10.3 SR2) and a symbolic-character (8.3.3.6.2 Format 7) are accepted and a concatenation expression folds. Negative: SUPPRESS WHEN 5 / N"A" on PIC X / ALL "AB" each draw SR7; positive golden accepts figurative, ALL, national, constant-name, symbolic-character, concatenation.
